intent: Vertical sidebar navigation with title, optional grouped catalog, and active item state.
useWhen: Playground or product shells with a persistent left sidebar
List-detail layouts with a small flat list of section links
doNotUseWhen: Product top bar with logo and search — use AppHeader

itemShape.label: string
itemShape.items: optional array of leaf links (one subgroup level)

items.note: Flat list for simple shells. Ignored when groups is provided.

groups.note: Grouped catalog nav. Takes precedence over items when present. Groups collapse; only one is open at a time. defaultOpen sets the initial group when no leaf is active.

precedence: When both items and groups are passed, groups wins; items is ignored.

passthrough.note: aria-label defaults to "Application" and can be overridden.

cssVars.--appnav-item-gap: Gap between groups, rows and sub-rows (space-1)
cssVars.--appnav-item-padding: Padding of links, group toggles and subgroup labels (space-2 space-3)
cssVars.--appnav-item-active-background: Active link fill (action-primary at 10% over surface-card)

requirements: Group labels are disclosure buttons with aria-expanded
Closed group lists are aria-hidden and inert

doNot: Do not invent local Sidebar or AppNav
Do not invent Sidebar, SidebarProvider, or local nav chrome — use SideNav
Do not use AppNav for tab panels — use Tabs
Do not nest more than one subgroup level
Do not set component variables to raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps — use semantic tokens
snippet: <AppNav title="Agentic DS Kit" groups={[{ label: 'Components', items: [{ href: '/components#button', label: 'Button', active: true }] }]} />
